passages.title: Monday breakfast
passages.text: Breakfast is scheduled on Monday only, from 6:00 AM until 7:00 AM.

passages.title: Morning prayer
passages.text: The 5 AM prayer on Monday lasts fifteen minutes, from 5:00 AM to 5:15 AM.

passages.title: Algorithm exercises
passages.text: Leetcode practice takes place Monday and Wednesday from 5:00 AM to 7:30 AM. Prayer and breakfast overlap this practice.

passages.title: Geometry lecture
passages.text: An isometry preserves distances. Rotations and reflections are examples of isometries.

passages.title: التسجيل الجامعي
passages.text: يجب تسليم استمارة تحويل الساعات المعتمدة إلى مكتب التسجيل قبل يوم الخميس. لا تُرسل الاستمارة إلى المكتبة.

passages.title: Vector freshness
passages.text: Editing a source marks its search vector stale. Stale passages are excluded until the current source has been embedded again.

passages.title: Database synchronization
passages.text: A row lock holds the current source unchanged while its content hash and resulting embedding are committed in the same transaction.
